question: 18 men can complete (1)/(5) of a work in 10 days. How many people are required to complete (2)/(5) of the same work in 5 days?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Using the MDH formula: (M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

Given: (18 × 10) / (1/5) = (M₂ × 5) / (2/5)

⇒ 180 × 5 = M₂ × 5 × (5/2)

⇒ 180 = M₂ × (5/2)

⇒ M₂ = (180 × 2) / 5 = 72

**∴ The correct option is A.**

Initial men (M₁) = 18

Initial days (D₁) = 10
